summary: Executed full backend regression (12 pytest cases) and focused frontend/admin Playwright checks on the public URL. Product create/edit/stock/delete, order stock deduction, owner/customer email flows, retry/email-test guardrails, reports export, documentation download, settings rename/revert, and responsive overflow checks passed.

critical.issue: Auth playbook mismatch: admin password is stored as plain text in env and compared directly (no bcrypt $2b$ hash flow, no seed-admin hash rotation path).

minor.issue: API responses still use wildcard CORS origin and no app-managed httpOnly auth cookie (bearer token in JSON/localStorage flow).

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid owner email did not surface app-level error banner (`settings-error` remained absent); validation currently relies on native browser input behavior.

action_items: If auth playbook requirements are mandatory, migrate ADMIN_PASSWORD to bcrypt hash verification and add/update seeded admin hash rotation logic.
If cookie-based auth is intended, move from wildcard CORS + localStorage token pattern to explicit origins + credentialed httpOnly cookie session handling.
Add explicit in-app invalid owner-email feedback (not only native browser constraint UI) for consistent UX/testability.
critical_code_review_comments: `server.py` login still uses `hmac.compare_digest` against plain env password, which is operationally simple but below modern credential-storage expectations.
Auth/CORS implementation does not match the optional cookie-based playbook checks (explicit origin + allow_credentials + app cookie).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (critical admin/storefront flows passed; one validation UX gap)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ products during API/UI runs and cleaned them. Created isolated test orders using delivered@resend.dev recipients; order records remain because no delete-order endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings were restored to store_name=Bhose Technology and owner_email blank/null. Public URL tested end-to-end. Historical test orders with TEST Buyer/TEST Retry names now exist and can be reused for orders/report/email-status checks.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (auth playbook mismatch): login implementation in `server.py` is token-based and compares plain env password directly, so bcrypt/hash-rotation and cookie-session checks cannot pass by design. RCA-2 (owner email invalid feedback): Settings form uses `<input type='email'>`; invalid input is blocked by browser-native constraint before API submit, so component-level `settings-error` is not guaranteed to render.
